entities.summary: Michael Anthony Sanders is an American former professional basketball player who played primarily as a small forward. He was selected by the Kansas City Kings in the fourth round and was the 74th overall pick in the 1982 NBA draft. He is a former assistant coach for the Utah Jazz of the National Basketball Association (NBA). Prior to being an assistant coach for Tyrone Corbin, Sanders was the team's director of player development.
